statements.basis: procedure_code and diagnosis_codes records list I49.5
statements.statement: The patient has a documented diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and lightheadedness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial management
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study (CPT 93226) is indicated
Associated symptoms are documented under R42
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the patient's current benefit plan
